thread:
Clare: Quick heads-up — all-hands begins in 20. Primary stream: Zoom -> OBS -> YouTube. If Zoom recording flakes, fallback is Loom local recorder. Jamal will handle the Q&A hand-off. Drop live questions in #all-hands-questions and pin items requiring leadership follow-up.

Jamal: I can run the Q&A handoff. Two asks: 1) enable closed captions (Zoom captions are unreliable), 2) keep slides in presenter mode so notes are visible.

Ana: +1 on captions. If Zoom captions drop, can YouTube auto-captions be allowed as a backup? Also set room mic sensitivity to -6dB to avoid gating on ambient noise.

Zoe: I'll draft a single slide for the leadership Q&A handoff (names + two bullets each). Can someone pin the Q&A doc link here?

DevOps Bot: OBS RTMP to primary: rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2/streamkey — fallback to Loom local recording if RTMP fails. Posting stream events to #all-hands-ops.

Matt: I'll monitor the caption feed and latency. If captions fail, I'll initiate RTMP retry and post the new ingest URL in this thread.

Jamal: Quick technical note: add a browser source in the OBS scene for caption overlay. Suggested CSS for readability: `#captions { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding:6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:20px; }`

Clare: Logistics: 1) if local recording stops, Ops will keep the live stream up for 10 minutes while we migrate recordings, 2) Leadership Q&A begins at T+15 — surface follow-ups in the pinned doc.

Zoe: Pinned Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/all-hands/2026-q2-qa — add follow-ups there and tag owners.

DevOps Bot: Recording started — https://storage.internal/recordings/1979991234.mp4 :record_button:

Ana: Presenters: enable "show speaker notes" in presenter view and upload final slides to the shared folder now.

Jamal: Got it. I'll cue leaders at T+14 and hand to Clare for the close. :thumbsup:
